byte_identity_note: user-bandwidth runs: not rerun unless lock time remains (cost ~N min per run); never claimed byte-identical without a rerun

A_user_bandwidth_stalls.B_justification: Fixed from the layer arithmetic-intensity distribution alone (min 2.0, median ~250, max ~597 FLOP/B) before any run: peak = 2*128*128 = 32768 FLOP/cycle, ridge = peak/B = 2048 (low: every layer below the ridge), 512 (mid: nearly all below), 128 (high: roughly half above). AMENDED: the registered 'low' level (B=16, ridge 2048) is dropped on cost alone; mid and high keep their registered ridge positions (512, 128 FLOP/B).
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.keys: InterfaceBandwidth=USER; Bandwidth = IfmapSRAMBankBandwidth = FilterSRAMBankBandwidth = B; IfmapSRAMBankNum = FilterSRAMBankNum = 1 (single_layer_sim.py takes the ifmap/filter DRAM-side bandwidth from the *SRAMBankBandwidth keys and the ofmap bandwidth from Bandwidth; read_buffer.py asserts bank_bandwidth*num_bank == total)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.knob_sanity: per dataflow, total stall cycles over the 21 layers are non-increasing from mid (B=64) to high (B=256)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.per_dataflow_pass: Spearman rho(AI, stall_frac) <= -0.6 at BOTH levels (mid and high) AND rho < +0.3 at both. A (dataflow, B) cell with fewer than 5 layers having stall_frac > 0 is uninformative and counts as NOT satisfying rho <= -0.6. (Stricter than the registered '>= 2 of 3 levels'.)
A_user_bandwidth_stalls.signal: stall_frac = Stall Cycles / Total Cycles per layer (COMPUTE_REPORT.csv)

B_calc_bandwidth_mode.keys: bundled scale.cfg unchanged: InterfaceBandwidth=CALC (SCALE-Sim computes the DRAM bandwidth each layer needs; no limit enforced)
B_calc_bandwidth_mode.signal: required_bw = Avg IFMAP DRAM BW + Avg FILTER DRAM BW + Avg OFMAP DRAM BW (BANDWIDTH_REPORT.csv, words/cycle)

criteria.amendment: P2-A2 (Decision P2-7, option 1), COST ONLY, committed before any criterion-A run was queued; no criterion-A result existed when it was written. Evidence: model/t3_roofline2_amendment_A2_rule.md, logs/part2/31_roofline_fix/cost_probe.log.
criteria.intensity: AI = 2*M*N*K / (unique ifmap tensor + filter + ofmap bytes), compulsory traffic, 1 byte/word (SCALE-Sim hard-codes word_size=1)
criteria.layer_set: ALL 21 layers of the bundled topology arch/bundled/topologies/conv_nets/Resnet18.csv (real layers, no hand-picked synthetic set); conv->GEMM mapping as in SCALE-Sim topology_utils (ofmap = ceil((H-Fh+s)/s)).

machine.array: 128x128 (cost-driven: 32x32 needs ~15 min per run, 12 runs x 2 reruns does not fit the queue; 128x128 ~6 min)
machine.base_config: bundled arch/bundled/configs/scale.cfg (SRAM 64 kB per buffer, ReadRequestBuffer 32) with only ArrayHeight/Width, Dataflow and the interface-bandwidth keys overridden

criteria.overall_pass: A passes for all 3 dataflows at both levels AND knob_sanity holds for all 3 AND B passes for all 3 dataflows AND reruns are byte-identical where a rerun exists (in-stage: bundled + fit; make repro: + CALC runs; user-bandwidth runs reported 'not rerun (cost)' unless lock time remains). PASS only if every pre-registered criterion has been evaluated and passes; unevaluated cells are reported as in_progress / not_run and keep the stage open. Thresholds are final. Failure = FAIL with diagnosis.

design.B_justification: Fixed from the layer arithmetic-intensity distribution alone (min 2.0, median ~250, max ~597 FLOP/B) before any run: peak = 2*128*128 = 32768 FLOP/cycle, ridge = peak/B = 2048 (low: every layer below the ridge), 512 (mid: nearly all below), 128 (high: roughly half above).
design.keys: InterfaceBandwidth=USER; Bandwidth = IfmapSRAMBankBandwidth = FilterSRAMBankBandwidth = B; IfmapSRAMBankNum = FilterSRAMBankNum = 1 (single_layer_sim.py takes the ifmap/filter DRAM-side bandwidth from the *SRAMBankBandwidth keys and the ofmap bandwidth from Bandwidth; read_buffer.py asserts bank_bandwidth*num_bank == total)
design.knob_sanity: per dataflow, total stall cycles over the 21 layers are non-increasing as B goes low -> mid -> high
design.per_dataflow_pass: Spearman rho(AI, stall_frac) <= -0.6 at >= 2 of the 3 bandwidth levels AND rho < +0.3 at all 3 levels. A (dataflow, B) cell with fewer than 5 layers having stall_frac > 0 is uninformative and counts as NOT satisfying rho <= -0.6.
design.signal: stall_frac = Stall Cycles / Total Cycles per layer (COMPUTE_REPORT.csv)

superseded_design.reason: not executable: > 27 min per (dataflow, B) run of 21 layers at 128x128 (stopped by main after 26 min 44 s, no output), >= 4.5 h of lock per pass; large layers > 170 s each at 1.7 GB RSS on both candidate arrays
